title: House Robber
prompt:
`nums[i]` is the cash in house `i`. You can't rob two **adjacent** houses. Return the maximum you can rob.

**Example**: `[2,7,9,3,1]` → `12` (rob 2 + 9 + 1).

The pattern lesson's exact recurrence: at each house, skip it or rob it.
hints: dp[i] = best loot from houses 0..i = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i]).
Rolling variables: `prev1` (best through the previous house) and `prev2` (best through two back).
Initialize both to 0 and loop over every house — no index special-casing needed.

solution.explanation: O(n)/O(1). Starting both variables at 0 ("no houses yet") makes the first two iterations compute the bases automatically — a cleaner start than special-casing nums[0] and nums[1].
